note: DEMO CONFIG (Phase 1) - NOT the real camera setup. These four zones sit on four students at the near table in data/demo/canteen-crowd.mp4 (1280x720). Use with: python run.py --camera data/demo/canteen-crowd.mp4 --cameras data/cameras.canteen.json

cameras.label: Demo clip - school canteen
cameras.notes: The camera drifts about 25 px over the 21 s clip, so these zones are accurate at the start and approximate at the end - the 'crowd' clip is evidence for detection and for state changes, not for pixel-exact zone placement. This is a bench-style canteen, so a 'seat' is the patch of bench a student occupies, not a separate chair object. ghost_seconds is 25 CAMPUS seconds for the demo only.
